patch.value: Align SDK producer-continuation result types with sparse reference envelopes

During default-list acceptance, native PmClient.list({brief:true,limit:'1',after:cursor}) returns a sparse reference envelope ending with next_cursor:null; fields such as has_more and sorting are intentionally absent. ListResultBase and ListVerboseResult still require those fields, and PmReadOutputResultFor considers budget/session/outputCursor but not producer after options. Audit the public return-type contract against the advertised continuation envelope before choosing a fix; preserve the intentional runtime metadata-reference optimization.

Type fixtures reflect first-page and producer-continuation envelopes without promising absent fields; CLI SDK and MCP serialized continuations retain complete membership and sparse metadata; public surface compatibility and packed consumer checks pass
Typed SDK callers can handle sparse producer continuations safely without casts or assumptions about omitted first-page metadata.
